items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he and I were good buddies

ctx.x: Because that sounds like a white man‘s name. Joe Kennedy, you said? No, that was not him. Joe Kennedy. No, I‘ll tell you his name because he and I were good buddies, I can‘t think, I just my mind is doing things to me at times and then as soon as we get through talking he‘ll come, here he comes.
Well, we‘ll come, maybe this will come back to you, we‘ll plug it in tomorrow.
